data_point: Newly incorporated, no live website, no disclosed funding
run_when: The website did not load and search results are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether this is a newly incorporated entity with no live website and no disclosed funding.
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Never exclude on an inference, an estimate or missing information. All three must hold: newly formed, no live domain, no funding found.
yes_when: Search results show a recent incorporation AND no working website AND no funding news
no_when: Results show funding, an older company, or a working website elsewhere
unknown_when: Results don't show the incorporation date
watch_out_for: A dead domain alone does not prove the company is new
where_to_look: Other domains for the same company

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.
